test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between B and D. Only two people sit to the left of B. F is not an immediate neighbour of D. F sits second to the right of G. A sits to the immediate right of E. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
**Given:**

Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

**Solution steps by steps:**

(1.) Only three people sit between B and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60d07002a5d3031340c432ab7e0c4ce51af2a2ff4fe417f810f35eb485a5d128.png] 

(2.) Only two people sit to the left of B.

 Only **case 1 is qualified** because in Case 2 , more than two people sit to let of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/741699205198288fa273b9b34f1bde8eb3c4107cc1fad085f7e4cc39be7cf0a1.png] 

(3.) F is not an immediate neighbour of D and F sits second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29288440964ae8cfade8fbc37434cd77fa236c68608399539cb9994a12d626f5.png] 

 (4.) A sits to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c423818c9f01ac17325f7619ab992f6b4889856601a2e2534c93315b7dabc395.png] 

(5.) Now only unoccupied position C is the left extreme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/182adba2557453ebce43aff0432b74ceb203b5b6f8ef021876f859f126bd6ff0.png] 

**Hence, 'C' sits at the extreme left end of the row.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1.**
